ends.note: dead end at the rear of the Walnut Street lots, east of the bridge approach

notes: This sheet has two separate map panels with their own placement: the upper panel (E. 3rd to E. Pearl, Vine to Walnut, y about 600-1650) and the lower panel (E. Pearl to E. 2nd, y about 2750-4150). E. Pearl appears in both, so the Pearl crossings are recorded twice, once per panel. The Approach to Bridge (printed APPROACH TO BRIDGE (RE-INFORCED CONCRETE), a later paste-over, walls about 180 px / 50 ft apart) runs north-south through both blocks from E. 3rd to E. 2nd, continuing south of 2nd onto sheet 101 toward the Suspension Bridge. Its walls are drawn into E. Pearl's roadway as far as the centreline from both sides, and the sheet does not show whether it crosses Pearl at grade or above it; if it is raised there, the two Approach/Pearl points should be dropped. It ends at E. 3rd (T). Dunseth Alley (printed DUNSETH ALLEY, about 18 ft between faces, no width printed) runs east from Vine, its face lines are drawn straight across the approach strip, and it dead-ends at the rear of the Walnut Street lots (x about 2465); the approach crossing is recorded as a cross, which assumes it is at grade there. Vine's east face near 2nd was not detected, so Vine/2nd uses the west face plus 33 ft. The lower-panel approach centreline drifts from x 2252 at Pearl to 2270 at 2nd.
